metadata.case_name: CHIU KAM SANG v. TAO KEE ENG COMPANY LIMITED AND NISHIMATSU CONSTRUCTION COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: steel bending and fixing worker / steel binder
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: light and sedentary work such as a cashier, operator or messenger

injuries.description: brachial plexus injury of the right shoulder
source: He was diagnosed to have suffered a brachial plexus injury of the right shoulder and given conservative treatment with physiotherapy.

It is common ground that the Plaintiff suffered a brachial plexus injury on his right side as a result of which he suffers right upper limb sensory and motor deficit as well as neck pain and impaired neck movement.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at shoulder or upper arm level

manifestations.description: Right upper limb sensory and motor deficit
Neck pain and impaired neck movement
Loss of consciousness for a short time at the time of the accident
Limited / tentative physical mobility observed (uses walking stick)

treatments_received: Admission to Prince of Wales Hospital Accident and Emergency Department and Orthopaedics and Traumatology Department
Pain clinic treatment and Comprehensive Outpatient Pain Engagement program at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital
Psychiatric treatment at Castle Peak Hospital
MRI investigations at Guangdong Province Clinic Medical Hospital

losses.description: Unable to return to pre-accident employment as a steel binder; limited to light and sedentary work such as cashier, operator or messenger.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Reduced ability to engage in sports and hobbies which he previously enjoyed as an active man.
